title: CERO Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — Entry into Material Definitive Agreement
summary: CERO Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. issued a $350,000 convertible promissory note with a $437,500 principal face value to Keystone Capital Partners, LLC on April 8, 2026. The note bears 10% annual interest, matures April 9, 2027, and is convertible into common stock at the lesser of $0.05 or 80% of the five lowest intraday trading prices during the prior 20 days. The maximum borrowing capacity under the facility is $1,000,000.
key_points: Company issued convertible note for $350,000 with $437,500 principal face value on April 8, 2026
Note bears 10% per annum interest and matures on April 9, 2027
Lender may convert principal and accrued interest into common stock at the lesser of $0.05 or 80% of the 5 lowest intraday trading prices in the preceding 20 days
Maximum aggregate borrowing under the facility is $1,000,000
Issuance was exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Rule 506(b)
Company is required to file a registration statement on Form S-1 or S-3 for resale of conversion shares
